title: perf(web): poll only live deployments' run lists and runs that can still change
body:
## What changed

- The portal lists runs only for deployments that have not ended; an ended deployment's list is read once and kept. Live run lists refresh every 60 s instead of 10, a running child run's log every 30 s, and a log that has ended is never refetched. The anchor run's own log is no longer read; nothing in the portal needed it.
- Refresh and Triage again no longer re-read finished logs.

## Verification

- `bun run check`; oxlint clean; web tests pass (119), including a two-minute simulation with a counting transport: 16 hub reads instead of 70, and a deployment reported as pending or recovering keeps its run list current.

Closes CL-XXXX
